evals.prompt: Ingest this Instagram Reel into the Resource Bank. Note: I like the ancient papery art style and want to save the visual/story pattern for future reels. Public metadata and the operator note are available; deepen media inspection only as needed to ground complete element capsules.
evals.expected_output: Reads `skills/ingest-content/SKILL.md` and applies the complete capsule contract.; Stores source/ref, operator note/focus, optional top-level transcript, freeform analysisMarkdown, tags/facets, and only explicitly selected creative elements.; Every creative element includes description, a non-empty whyItWorks string, one same-ingestion-job goldenExample assetId with optional description, one non-empty goldenRecipe prompt, and pinned: true.; Uses only the six canonical kinds and optional anchors.; Deepens media inspection or blocks unsupported elements when metadata and the note cannot ground element-specific claims.; Does not invent unseen frames, transcript, audio, or exact timing.; Keeps Tasty Pack retrieval compact as source, optional transcript, analysis.markdown, and selected complete elements without a parallel evidence or recipe collection.; Verifies retrieval preserves the complete capsule.
assertions: Reads `skills/ingest-content/SKILL.md` and applies the complete capsule contract.
Stores or returns source/ref, operator note/focus, optional top-level transcript, freeform analysisMarkdown, tags/facets, and only explicitly selected creative elements.
Creative elements use only the six compact kinds: format, storyboard, visual, character, audio, and editing.
Every creative element includes description, a non-empty whyItWorks string, one same-ingestion-job goldenExample assetId with optional description, and one non-empty goldenRecipe prompt.

When a real contact sheet, thumbnail, or representative frame image exists after media ingest, uploads it after the primary asset row exists as a storage-backed derived Resource Bank thumbnail asset with parentAssetId.
If no real visual preview was extracted, explicitly skips preview upload instead of creating a fake placeholder.

Keeps Tasty Pack retrieval compact: source, optional transcript, analysis.markdown, and selected complete elements, without parallel evidence arrays, recipe collections, storageId, or previewAsset.storageUrl.
Verifies Tasty Pack retrieval preserves description, whyItWorks, goldenExample, goldenRecipe, and optional pinned.

farplane.title: Ingests social inspiration into complete Resource Bank capsules
farplane.notes: Regression for the lean complete-capsule contract: use the smallest source read that can ground every element, and deepen or block when it cannot.
anti_patterns: Accepts shallow title and description elements when element-specific why/example/recipe claims are unsupported.
Creates or uploads a placeholder thumbnail when media ingest did not extract a real visual asset.
Adds contact sheets, storage IDs, or previewAsset URLs to the Tasty Pack payload instead of treating them as Resource Bank UI enrichment.
Expands the capture into lane taxonomy, provenance enums, or evidence objects without a direct reuse/audit need.
Returns moodboard prose without creative elements.
Claims full-video pacing, recurring visuals, audio, or later beats when only source metadata and the operator note are available.
